summary: Created one wide-bandgap power-semiconductor idea. NVIDIA's 800 VDC ecosystem and DOE evidence support the engineering mechanism, while production timing, qualification, yield, utilization, pricing, packaging, capital intensity, and silicon competition block a broad supplier conclusion. No unverified ticker association or strategy was created.

evidence.claim: NVIDIA's next-generation architecture reduces current, copper, cable bulk, and conversion stages and is intended to migrate gradually from existing systems.
Infineon introduced 650 V GaN intermediate-bus reference designs for plus-or-minus 400 V and 800 V AI-server systems in 2026.

evidence.source: US Department of Energy power-electronics R&D
evidence.claim: DOE identifies higher efficiency and operating temperature as WBG advantages while treating cost, reliability, packaging, and integration as necessary development work.
DOE closed a USD 544 million loan for SiC wafer capacity, confirming EV adoption and capacity expansion that may also create oversupply risk.

daily_report_items: Researched SiC and GaN adoption: architecture and physics are credible, but supplier qualification, utilization, pricing, capital intensity, and valuation block a strategy.
